mapper.select: SELECT std.DOCUMENT_ID, PDOC.STATENO MATCHED_STATENO, FIRST_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME, LAST_NAME, to_char(DOB, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DOB, VSEQID, to_char(VSEQCREATIONDATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') VSEQCREATIONDATE, RECORDS_GROUPED_COUNT, RESISTANCE_DOC_ID_1, to_char(RESISTANCE_TEST_DATE_1, 'MM/DD/YYYY') RESISTANCE_TEST_DATE_1, RESISTANCE_DOC_ID_2, to_char(RESISTANCE_TEST_DATE_2, 'MM/DD/YYYY') RESISTANCE_TEST_DATE_2, RESISTANCE_DOC_ID_3, to_char(RESISTANCE_TEST_DATE_3, 'MM/DD/YYYY') RESISTANCE_TEST_DATE_3, GENESFOUNDTEXT, PHYLOSUBTYPE, RESISTANCE_DRUG_CLASS_PR, RESISTANCE_DRUG_CLASS_NRTI, RESISTANCE_DRUG_CLASS_NNRTI, RESISTANCE_DRUG_CLASS_IN FROM STD_RAS_DOC std INNER JOIN document_locator D ON (std.DOCUMENT_ID = D.DOCUMENT_ID and std.DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId}) LEFT OUTER JOIN person_doc_association PDOC ON (std.DOCUMENT_ID = PDOC.DOCUMENT_ID and PDOC.DISSASSOCIATION_DATE is null)
SELECT LISTAGG(gene_name, '_') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seq_result_id) AS description FROM ras_si_gene where seq_Result_id = #{SEQ_RESULT_ID}

select distinct drug_Class from ras_si_drug_score where ((resistance_level > 3 and (DRUG_CLASS in ('PI', 'NRTI', 'NNRTI') )) or (resistance_level > 2 and (DRUG_CLASS in ('INSTI')))) and seq_Result_id = #{SEQ_RESULT_ID}
SELECT count(*) as isLinked FROM GEN_SEQUENCE WHERE LAB_DOC_ID = #{documentId} and RAS_ELIG = 'Y' and VLINK_DATE is not null
mapper.update: UPDATE GEN_SEQUENCE SET RAS_ELIG = #{rasElig}, VLINK_DATE = null WHERE LAB_DOC_ID = #{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT BHAEGENESUM FROM RASSEQUENCELINKS WHERE LAB_DOC_ID = #{documentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE RASSEQUENCELINKS SET VSEQSTATUS = 2, VSEQDEACTIVATIONDATE = SYSDATE, VSEQDEACTIVATIONUSER = #{user_id}, VSEQDEACTIVATIONREASON = 'RES_DEL_EDIT' WHERE VSEQID in ( SELECT VSEQID FROM RASSEQUENCELINKS WHERE LAB_DOC_ID = #{documentId})

UPDATE STD_RAS_DOC SET CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 9 WHERE CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS = 5 and (RESISTANCE_DOC_ID_1 = #{documentId} or RESISTANCE_DOC_ID_2 = #{documentId} or RESISTANCE_DOC_ID_3 = #{documentId})
mapper.select: SELECT LAB_DOC_ID FROM RASSEQUENCELINKS WHERE VSEQID = ( SELECT VSEQID FROM RASSEQUENCELINKS WHERE LAB_DOC_ID = #{documentId} and VSEQSTATUS = 1 )
